model_families.T0_LEAGUE_HOME_AWAY: lambda_home=training mean home goals; lambda_away=training mean away goals
model_families.T1_SHRUNK_ROLLING_TEAM_RATE: side-specific recent team scoring and conceding rates, shrunk toward league home/away rates, averaged for attack and opponent defence
model_families.T2_REGULARIZED_ATTACK_DEFENCE: weighted ridge-penalized Poisson attack-defence model with log(lambda_home)=intercept+home_advantage+attack[home]+defence[away] and log(lambda_away)=intercept+attack[away]+defence[home]; higher defence means weaker defence
model_families.T3_DIXON_COLES: T2 attack-defence structure plus a weighted Dixon-Coles low-score dependence parameter rho fitted from training results only
